acceptance_verification.AC1_authoritative_snapshot_truth_and_url: Removed the hardcoded 'snap-2026-q3-final' fallback and removed the savedProposal ranking_snapshot_id fallback from servedSnapshotId in QuarterlyRanking.tsx. Evaluation Context Snapshot ID now resolves strictly from authoritative current ranking response rows (ranking_snapshot_id / rankingSnapshotId on active/ranked rows) or renders 'unavailable' when current ranking rows do not expose an authoritative snapshot identity, never equating saved recommendation source snapshot identity (ranking-quarterly-2026-q4-29eb48a0455252e2a2f9d27a) with current Evaluation Context snapshot identity (ranking-quarterly-2026-q4-2fe05fbe2c40dff7778d5e22). Row-level saved recommendation source/rationale provenance and separate 'Requested Snapshot:' URL display remain preserved.
acceptance_verification.AC2_preserve_owner_recommendation_formul: Preserved useSavedProposals, ProposalCell (including row-level evaluator_run_id and ranking_snapshot_id provenance), quarterly selection, score formulas, and read-only human-decision boundaries without any BFF, schema, protocol, mode, provider, or business action changes.
acceptance_verification.AC3_scoped_page_and_focused_test_coverag: Updated only QuarterlyRanking.tsx and the focused test in RankingRecommendationPages.test.tsx (plus this task evidence manifest) to discriminate current Evaluation Context identity from saved recommendation provenance and assert honest 'unavailable' when current row snapshot identity is absent.
